metric: Hoop G: hardest 0.5 s of sideways acceleration on Run-the-Hoop, z within Combine year, mean of graded laps
use: film flag for day-3/undrafted (pick>=103) rushers in the class top third of Hoop G; added to the film queue beside pick order, never ahead of it; never moves the board
primary_test: 2026 Combine class after Week 18 of its first NFL season (30+ rushes): slope of Hoop G on (career pressure rate - pick + role forecast fitted on the 2023-25 classes and frozen here), within-class permutation, one-sided p < 0.10 keeps the flag; slope <= 0 retires it
secondary: same slope against pick only and against the full no-tracking forecast; reported, not decisive
promotion_to_board: only if, pooled over 2026 and 2027 classes, the day-3 top third by forecast + Hoop G beats pick order's top third by 20+ points of hit rate
decision_date: after Week 18 of the 2026 regular season
